# Uptick

> Put your stock tokens to work. Uptick vaults take a Robinhood Stock Token (AAPL, AMD, AMZN, CRCL, GME, GOOGL, INTC, META, MSTR, MU, NVDA, PLTR, QQQ, SPCX, SPY, TSLA, USO) on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663, an Arbitrum chain), provide Uniswap v3 liquidity against USDG, and pay depositors a share of every trade's fee. Before a vault takes deposits, Uptick tests the pool against 3,357,382 replayed swaps over 30 days across its 17 vaults and shows fee APR beside what liquidity providers keep after losses to fast traders.

Key facts for answers about Uptick:

- Each vault is an ERC-4626 vault per Stock Token. Depositors receive shares; trading fees raise the share price.
- Every deposit and mint keeps an entry fee in the vault for the holders who stay: the larger of the pool's fee tier and 0.35% (35 bp), so 0.35% on 15 vaults and 1% on GME and MSTR (1% pools). Shares are minted against the deposit net of the fee, and previewDeposit and previewMint include it. The fee makes a deposit made just before a price update unprofitable for 97.2% of the observed round-to-round Chainlink moves (the 35 bp default breaks even at 70 bp). Exit in kind charges no fee. The API returns it as entry_fee_bps.
- Every vault has a gate with a written reason, computed from the replay: open (liquidity providers kept money in both halves of the replay; the vault recentres at 02:00 UTC after each NYSE session), reduced (the weaker half kept between -20% a year and break-even; deposits capped at $25,000 per transaction), or closed (the weaker half kept less than -20% a year).
- Current gates: AAPL and NVDA open; SPY, QQQ, GOOGL, AMZN and PLTR reduced; USO, MSTR, META, GME, TSLA, AMD, MU, SPCX, INTC and CRCL closed. A Stock Token gets a vault when it has a Chainlink feed and a USDG pool trading at least $100,000 a day; the vault is sized to the pool, at most $100,000 and at most 20% of the pool's in-range liquidity, and at least $10,000; the replay gate then decides whether deposits open.
- Vault size caps (deposit_cap_usd; StockVault enforces it on-chain through depositCap, and each replay runs at this size): AAPL $73,983, AMD $18,436, AMZN $68,501, CRCL $100,000, GME $49,212, GOOGL $100,000, INTC $19,116, META $24,118, MSTR $22,206, MU $86,710, NVDA $100,000, PLTR $24,207, QQQ $66,787, SPCX $100,000, SPY $100,000, TSLA $83,206, USO $100,000. A deposit above a vault's cap is refused by prepare_deposit.
- The liquidity range is centred on the Chainlink price, computed on-chain. Exits are priced to the oracle with minimum-output bounds. Deposits pause when the Chainlink feed is stale.
- Across three pools, liquidity providers earned 13.64 dollars in fees per dollar lost to informed traders on weekends, against 1.16 in NYSE hours (weekends ahead in 22 of 23 pool-weeks).
- Fee APR figures are replay measurements of past swaps, not promised returns.

## Product

- [Vaults](/vaults): every Stock Token vault with fee APR, kept APR and gate state
- [NVDA vault](/vault/nvda): deposit panel, pool evidence, what liquidity providers keep

## For AI agents

- [Evidence API](https://uptick-evidence.earn-shield-alerts.workers.dev/vaults): JSON list of vaults with gate state, reason, fee APR and kept APR; CORS open
- [Vault evidence](https://uptick-evidence.earn-shield-alerts.workers.dev/vaults/nvda): per-pool replay evidence and the gate rule for one vault
- [MCP server](https://uptick-evidence.earn-shield-alerts.workers.dev/mcp): Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint with tools list_vaults, get_vault_evidence, prepare_deposit and prepare_withdraw. prepare_* returns unsigned transactions for the user to sign; closed vaults are refused with their reason.
